Local Government | Temporary, 4 months | $63.67 - $69.47p/h + Super | Melbourne, Caulfield South   Your new company     A government organisation is seeking an experienced Health, Safety & Wellbeing Advisor to support the delivery of proactive safety, wellbeing and injury management practices across the organisation. This is an excellent opportunity to join a values-led team, supporting leaders and employees to strengthen safety capability, improve wellbeing outcomes and embed a positive, preventative safety culture.    Your new role     
 
 Providing timely advice and support to leaders and employees on health, safety, wellbeing and injury management matters   
 Supporting the implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of health, safety and wellbeing systems, procedures and frameworks   
 Assisting leaders to identify, assess and control workplace hazards, including psychosocial risks   
 Supporting incident reporting, investigations, root cause analysis and corrective action monitoring   
 Promoting early intervention and sustainable return-to-work outcomes in collaboration with leaders, insurers, rehabilitation providers and other stakeholders   
 Contributing to the design and delivery of wellbeing, health promotion and injury prevention initiatives   
 Developing and delivering safety, wellbeing and injury management training, including induction and system-based training   
 Maintaining accurate safety and wellbeing data, reporting, insights and trend analysis to support decision-making   
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Formal qualifications in Occupational Health and Safety, Work Health and Safety or a related discipline   
 Demonstrated experience supporting workers compensation claims management, early intervention and return-to-work coordination   
 Strong knowledge of health and safety management systems, including implementation, continuous improvement and user adoption   
 Experience developing and implementing workplace wellbeing, health promotion or injury prevention programs   
 Strong advisory and consulting skills, with the ability to connect safety, wellbeing and injury management matters to operational priorities   
 Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build trust, influence and gain cooperation from leaders, colleagues and external providers   
 Confidence using Microsoft Office and wellbeing, safety or incident management systems   
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in applying, please submit your latest CV in Word format to Lachlan.Knowles@hays.com.au. If this position isn't quite right for you, but you're open to exploring new Health, Safety or Wellbeing opportunities, please email your CV to start a confidential conversation.    Please  click here  to apply.
